title: Array of scalars one level down turns its parent object into an array
rationale: Pairs with the root-level fixture to show the heuristic is not merely absent but actively wrong once a prefix exists. The array-ness migrates up one level: the parent object becomes the array and the array becomes a scalar.
catchesBugClass: The fundamental ambiguity the flattened key format cannot express: a_b = "[x,y]" means either "a is an array of objects with field b" or "a is an object with an array-valued field b", and nothing in the wire format distinguishes them.
cannotCatch: It cannot be fixed by tuning the heuristic - this fixture and the array-of-objects fixture produce indistinguishable flattened output shapes, so any change that fixes this one breaks that one. It documents a wire-format gap, not a code bug.

predicted.detail: Prefix user sees a size-2 serialized array and is flagged as the array path, so the object becomes a 2-element array and the array becomes a scalar at every position.
